world.name: Terra
world.premise: In Terra, ancient powers stir beneath a fractured realm where kingdoms vie for control, forgotten magic resurfaces, and heroes must navigate shifting alliances to shape the fate of the world.

regions.name: The Verdant Expanse
regions.notes: A vast, lush forest region home to reclusive elves and ancient ruins.

regions.name: The Shattered Peaks
regions.notes: Jagged mountain range rich in minerals and dwarven strongholds.

regions.name: The Sunken Marshes
regions.notes: Misty wetlands inhabited by mysterious tribes and dangerous creatures.

regions.name: The Crimson Plains
regions.notes: Open grasslands where nomadic clans roam and frequent skirmishes occur.

landmarks.name: The Obsidian Spire
landmarks.notes: A towering black crystal tower said to be a source of ancient magic.

landmarks.name: The Eternal Flame
landmarks.notes: A sacred fire that never extinguishes, located in the heart of the Verdant Expanse.

landmarks.name: The Lost City of Vhal’Dun
landmarks.notes: Ruins submerged beneath the Sunken Marshes, rumored to hold forgotten knowledge.

cultures.name: Elari
cultures.traits: Elven society valuing harmony with nature, skilled in magic and archery, secretive.

cultures.name: Durnak
cultures.traits: Dwarven clans focused on craftsmanship, mining, and strong martial traditions.

cultures.name: Marashi
cultures.traits: Marsh-dwelling tribes adept in guerrilla tactics and shamanistic magic.

cultures.name: Khalari
cultures.traits: Nomadic horse clans emphasizing honor, swift raids, and oral storytelling.

magic.sources: Magic in Terra is drawn from ancient ley lines and the Obsidian Spire’s power.
magic.costs: Casting spells drains the caster’s vitality or requires rare components; overuse risks permanent harm.
magic.limits: Magic cannot create matter from nothing and is less effective in areas where ley lines are weak.

technology.notes: Swords, bows, basic siege engines, limited alchemy; no gunpowder or advanced machinery.

factions.name: The Silver Council
factions.agenda: Elven-led group seeking to preserve natural balance and control ancient magic.
factions.assets: Influence over Verdant Expanse, magical knowledge, elite rangers.

factions.name: The Iron Brotherhood
factions.agenda: Dwarven guild focused on mining wealth and expanding strongholds in the Shattered Peaks.
factions.assets: Fortified mountain cities, skilled smiths, mercenary forces.

factions.name: The Marshborn
factions.agenda: Coalition of Marashi tribes defending their homeland and reclaiming lost artifacts.
factions.assets: Swamp knowledge, shamanic magic, guerrilla fighters.

factions.name: The Crimson Riders
factions.agenda: Khalari clans united to raid and control trade routes across the plains.
factions.assets: Fast cavalry, intimate knowledge of terrain, tribal alliances.

economy.currencies: Gold coins minted by kingdoms; trade also uses silver and barter.
economy.trade: Minerals from mountains, magical components from forests, livestock and horses from plains, herbs and rare goods from marshes.

pantheon.name: Aeloria
pantheon.domain: Goddess of nature, growth, and renewal.

pantheon.name: Vorrak
pantheon.domain: God of war, strength, and honor.

pantheon.name: Selithar
pantheon.domain: God of knowledge, magic, and secrets.

pantheon.name: Nyxara
pantheon.domain: Goddess of death, fate, and the afterlife.

bestiary.name: Shadowfang
bestiary.role: Predatory wolf-like beasts that hunt in packs across the Crimson Plains.

bestiary.name: Marsh Wraith
bestiary.role: Ethereal spirits haunting the Sunken Marshes, draining life energy.

bestiary.name: Stonehide Golem
bestiary.role: Constructs guarding dwarven strongholds, animated by ancient runes.

bestiary.name: Sylvan Treant
bestiary.role: Ancient tree guardians protecting the Verdant Expanse.

hooks: A mysterious surge in magical energy emanates from the Obsidian Spire.
A lost artifact from Vhal’Dun resurfaces, sparking conflict among factions.
A plague spreads through the Crimson Plains, threatening nomadic clans.
An alliance between the Marshborn and the Silver Council is rumored but unconfirmed.
safety_tools: Establish session zero to discuss boundaries and player comfort.
Use the X-Card for on-the-fly content moderation.
Implement Lines and Veils to define sensitive topics.
Encourage open communication and check-ins after sessions.
dice_prompts: On a natural 1, the magic backfires with unexpected consequences.
On a natural 20, the caster gains a temporary boon from the ley lines.
A roll of even numbers grants additional insight or clues.
Odd numbers introduce complications or reveal hidden dangers.
